## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pull out the drawer of the slanted wooden cabinet and set the hard black box for card deck into it.

Task description: Put the black hard card box with an orange design at the front left of the table inside the drawer of the slanted wooden cabinet.

Success criteria: The drawer must be open and the card box inside, near its placement target laterally and longitudinally. Its height must be slightly above its former tabletop height while within the drawer placement range. The left gripper must be open and release the card box.

## Execution tips

- The card box is thin. Grip straight middle sections of opposite long edges, opening slightly wider than their separation. Confirm pads surround the sidewalls rather than pressing only its face or touching the table with fingertips.
- Grip an exposed section of the horizontal handle away from its end mounts, ensuring the fingers enclose it. Pull straight outward along the drawer's actual sliding direction to reduce jamming from sideways pulling or upward prying.
- Leave enough room at the drawer opening for the card box and gripper to pass. If adjusting the pose, do so in the wider area outside the opening to reduce contact between the box corners, fingers, cabinet, or drawer frame.
- When placing the card box, keep its broad face nearly flat. Check that its bottom rests on the drawer floor rather than the front edge, and release only after it is supported securely to avoid tipping it or catching it on the edge.
